name: Wan2.1-T2V-Cinematic
description: Wan 2.1 text-to-video workflow tuned for cinematic / documentary-style output. Uses a cinematic LORA for handheld, grainy film aesthetics.

prompt.description: Main text prompt describing the scene to generate.

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt to steer away from unwanted qualities.
negative_prompt.default: worst quality, low quality, blurry, distorted, deformed, ugly, bad anatomy, watermark, text, logo

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible generation. -1 for random.

steps.description: Number of denoising steps. Higher = better quality, slower.

cfg.description: Classifier-free guidance scale. How strongly to follow the prompt.

frame_count.description: Number of frames to generate (for video).

fps.description: Frames per second for the output video.
